title: VisualArtifactSpec 1.0: Evaluating Visual Artifacts under Task Specifications
author: Shuyi Ouyang, Xiaojun Tang, Zijian Zou, Xintong Zhang et al.
description: Visual artifact tasks test agents' ability to translate task specifications and source materials into outputs that meet practical needs. summary: Visual artifact tasks test agents' ability to translate task specifications and source materials into outputs that meet practical needs. Evaluation across artifact families helps distinguish broadly applicable authoring capabilities from strengths confined to a particular medium.
takeaways: VAS evaluates two aspects separately: Task Fulfillment verifies explicit requirements and applicable functionality, while Artifact Performance assesses Content, Organization, Visuals, and Delivery.
Existing benchmarks provide limited support for systematically evaluating how authoring choices suit different audiences, purposes, and media across artifact families.
We evaluate nine model-harness configurations on all 211 tasks.
